heading: Existing periods of trust and restrictions on alienation extended
lead: The existing periods of trust placed upon any Indian lands and any restriction on alienation thereof are extended and continued until otherwise directed by Congress.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 462 of this title prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.

ancestors.heading: PROTECTION OF INDIANS AND CONSERVATION OF RESOURCES
